name: Karel Hynek Mácha
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Karel Hynek Mácha (1810–1836), born in Prague, studied law and wrote poetry and prose in Czech. He died in Litoměřice at twenty-five, a few months after his one book of verse appeared.
Máj (May, 1836), a lyrical-epic poem in four cantos with two intermezzos, was coolly received in his lifetime and later became the founding work of modern Czech poetry.
